name: fake-server-local
description: A local REST API server that returns random lorem-ipsum data based on user-defined schemas, useful for front-end/app developers to test against before real APIs are ready.

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --require ts-node/register/transpile-only tests/storage.test.ts tests/generator.test.ts tests/dataGenerator.test.ts tests/database.service.test.ts tests/recordController.test.ts
